label: General
tooltip: FATEs, Critical Encounters, pots, BOCCHI AI, Triage Mode, treasure, delays, and repair.

prefer_pot_fates.label: Prefer pot FATEs
prefer_pot_fates.tooltip:
On: always do Magic Pot FATEs (order: pot, then CE, then other FATEs).
Off: CE, then pot, then other.
While on, pots stay required on the FATEs page.

should_farm_pot_chests.label: Farm pot chests after pot FATEs
should_farm_pot_chests.tooltip:
On: after a pot FATE, drink Magical Elixir and follow the compass while Cache Me lasts. If the compass doesn’t point to a chest, walk the known chest list instead.
Off: leave after the pot FATE without farming chests.

should_preposition_to_pots.label: Wait near pots before they spawn
should_preposition_to_pots.tooltip:
On: leave early and wait near the next pot. Timing is under Pot timing. Needs Do FATEs, and that pot allowed (or Prefer pot FATEs).
Off: do not leave early for pots.

leave_fate_travel_for_ce_seconds.label: Leave FATE travel for a CE when (seconds left)
leave_fate_travel_for_ce_seconds.tooltip: While walking to a FATE, switch to a CE only when registration has this many seconds or fewer left. Higher = leave sooner. 0 = switch as soon as a CE is up. Already in the FATE: finish it first.

combat_autorotation.label: Combat rotation
combat_autorotation.tooltip:
Which plugin runs your rotation in FATEs, CEs, and Mob Farmer fights.
Paused while traveling or pulling.
None: you fight manually.

disabled_wrath_occult_options.label: Phantom job actions BOCCHI may use (Wrath Combo)
disabled_wrath_occult_options.tooltip:
Unchecked actions stay off when BOCCHI takes over Wrath's Occult Crescent settings, e.g. Berserker Rage, which can make you eat mechanics.
Changes apply the next time Illegal Mode or Mob Farmer starts.
Hover an action to see its Wrath option name.
disabled_wrath_occult_options.empty: Wrath Combo is not loaded, or this Wrath version does not list phantom job options.
disabled_wrath_occult_options.built_in: BOCCHI always leaves this one off.

update_boss_mod_presets_automatically.label: Update presets automatically
update_boss_mod_presets_automatically.tooltip:
On: rewrite BOCCHI AI presets from the settings below when they change, Illegal Mode starts, or you change job / melee / ranged.
Off: keep current presets; press Update presets to apply the settings below.
update_boss_mod_presets_automatically.button_tooltip: Rebuild BOCCHI AI presets from the settings below now. Overwrites other BossMod edits on those presets.
update_boss_mod_presets_automatically.button_tooltip_auto_on: Not needed while Update presets automatically is on.

max_distance_by_role.label: Set max distance to target based on role
max_distance_by_role.tooltip:
On: melee uses melee distance (or stay on hitbox); ranged / caster / healer use ranged distance.
Off: one shared max distance.

melee_on_hitbox.label: Melee stay on hitbox
melee_on_hitbox.tooltip:
On: melee stands on the hitbox edge.
Off: use the melee distance in yalms. Sage always 5y and Dancer 10y when distance-by-role is on.

max_distance_melee.label: Max distance to target | Melee
max_distance_melee.tooltip: Ignored while Melee stay on hitbox is on.

overdodge.label: Extra dodge space
overdodge.tooltip: Extra space from dangerous areas while traveling.

delay.label: Delay movement
delay.tooltip: Wait this long before BOCCHI AI starts moving. Keep low or you can get hit.

separate_dodge_delay.label: Separate dodge delay
separate_dodge_delay.tooltip:
On: use Dodge delay movement for AoE dodges instead of Delay movement.
Off: use Delay movement for AoE dodges too.

dodge_delay.label: Dodge delay movement
dodge_delay.tooltip: Only used when Separate dodge delay is on.

stay_mounted_while_waiting_for_ce.label: Stay mounted while waiting for CEs

stop_after_return.label: Stop after return and teleport
stop_after_return.tooltip:
On: after a FATE or CE: Return, teleport toward the next one, mount, then stop. Toggle Illegal Mode to resume.
Off: keep running after Return.

phantom_jobs_leveling_mode.label: Level phantom jobs automatically
phantom_jobs_leveling_mode.tooltip: When your phantom job is maxed, switch to the next unlocked one that is not. Skips Freelancer.

enable_triage_mode.label: Triage Mode
enable_triage_mode.tooltip: After a FATE or CE, raise nearby dead players with your chosen phantom job, then continue. Skips anyone who already has a raise.

auto_accept_raise.label: Auto-accept raise
auto_accept_raise.tooltip: While dead, accept a raise from another player. The return-to-camp prompt is never accepted.

should_cast_treasure_sight.label: Cast Treasure Sight at camp
should_cast_treasure_sight.tooltip:
On: at camp, cast Treasure Sight on the Interval below when Auto treasure hunt is off.
Off: do not cast Sight at camp on a timer.
should_cast_treasure_sight.tooltip_disabled: Unavailable while Auto treasure hunt is on. That mode already casts Sight after a FATE or CE and while waiting at camp.

treasure_sight_recast_interval_seconds.label: Interval (seconds)
treasure_sight_recast_interval_seconds.tooltip: How often to cast Treasure Sight at camp while waiting. Used by Auto treasure hunt between activities, or by Cast Treasure Sight at camp when auto-hunt is off.

max_remote_idle_time_seconds.label: Max wait before Return (seconds)
max_remote_idle_time_seconds.tooltip: After a FATE or CE, wait a random time from 2s up to this before Return. If Treasure Sight is queued, Return immediately so Sight can land.

max_base_teleport_delay_seconds.label: Max wait before leaving camp (seconds)
max_base_teleport_delay_seconds.tooltip: At camp, wait 0 to this many seconds before leaving for a FATE or CE. 0 = leave right away.

auto_repair_method.label: Repair method
auto_repair_method.tooltip:
Self-repair: Repair action (needs crafter levels and dark matter).
Mender NPC: talk to a nearby mender at base camp (no crafter). If none is found, falls back to self-repair.
Prefer mender: mender when nearby, otherwise self-repair.
If repair fails or hangs, Illegal Mode skips it for a short time so it does not sit on Repairing forever.

enable_automatic_treasure_hunt_during_il.label: Auto treasure hunt in Illegal Mode
enable_automatic_treasure_hunt_during_il.tooltip:
On: after a FATE or CE, return to camp and run Treasure Sight if known. Starts a hunt when bronze/silver remaining meets the % on Treasure Hunter.
Also casts Sight at camp while waiting (Interval below), then hunts if enough chests remain — so you are not sitting idle between CEs.
Without Sight: uses the built-in chest list (those % ignored), always pauses for FATE/CE, then resumes.
Off: do not start treasure hunts from Illegal Mode.

pause_auto_treasure_hunt_for_fate.label: Pause auto treasure hunt for FATEs
pause_auto_treasure_hunt_for_fate.tooltip:
On: while Auto treasure hunt is running, pause when a FATE is available (or already in one), then resume nearby afterward.
Off: with Treasure Sight, keep hunting through FATEs (a hunt using the default chest list always pauses for FATEs).
Needs Auto treasure hunt in Illegal Mode.

pause_auto_treasure_hunt_for_pots.label: Pause auto treasure hunt for pots
pause_auto_treasure_hunt_for_pots.tooltip:
On: pause the hunt when Pot timing says leave for the next pot (or a pot is already up), then resume nearby afterward. Uses “Leave for pots this many minutes early” on Pot timing.
Off: keep hunting through pot leave-early (live pots still pause if Pause for FATEs is on, or always when using the default chest list without Sight).
Needs Auto treasure hunt in Illegal Mode, and farm pots or wait near pots.

pause_auto_treasure_hunt_for_critical_en.label: Pause auto treasure hunt for CEs
pause_auto_treasure_hunt_for_critical_en.tooltip:
On: while Auto treasure hunt is running, pause when a Critical Encounter is available (or already in one), then resume nearby afterward.
Off: with Treasure Sight, keep hunting through CEs (a hunt using the default chest list always pauses for CEs).
Needs Auto treasure hunt in Illegal Mode.
